label: YM cross-asset 20-day daily mean reversion overnight (Tuesday longs) true 4R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `SI 20-day daily mean reversion overnight (Tuesday longs)`. Daily time-series contrarian using a 20-day close-to-close lookback. Filter: long signals on weekday 1. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 4:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection.
verificationSummary: Cross-asset strict PF 2.36 over 90 trades; average planned RR 4.00, min planned RR 3.96; bootstrap p05 1.52, block-bootstrap p05 1.60, annual pass rate 100%.
